followup.purpose: Explicit nonconformance injection doubles exercise trusted-evidence wiring, all-sleeve positions/reservations, settled-share coverage, separate reviewed leg caps, ordered hashes, complete response correlations, limits/model IDs, expiry, canonical bytes and absent default runtime/evidence.

implementation.newAuthoring: Original Rust implementation against reviewed domain requirements; no legacy broker code or Fincept code copied.
implementation.arithmetic: Normalized exact canonical decimal strings, <=30 whole digits and <=18 fractional digits, checked i128 coefficient/operations, overflow/inexact rejection, upward currency liability rounding, no floats.
implementation.qualification: Immutable policy-pinned instrument/calendar hashes; exchange-local date/cutoff/expiry using explicit tzdb offset intervals; ambiguous or nonexistent local time rejected; no host clock, timezone or 16:00 default.
implementation.risk: Quote/rights/freshness/Greek provenance and units; explicit cost/latency policy; owner-observed readiness and durable kill state; five-sleeve settled cash/share budgets; portfolio Greek interval, gross/loss/position, per-instrument and per-expiry limits.
implementation.settlement: Independent-leg pessimism with no presumed spread atomicity or sale credits. Physical call exercise reserves strike cash in addition to premium; physical long puts and short calls reserve existing settled shares; short puts reserve strike cash; uncovered cash-settled short calls reject. No borrowing, margin or FX assumptions.
implementation.dispatch: Exact pending reservation replacement bound by key, sleeve, immutable strategy artifact and proposal hash set. Already-filled positions, other pending orders, unknown acceptance and kill flags remain included. Returned revision/head/epoch are CAS prerequisites, not durable admission.
implementation.paperOnly: PAPER-SIMULATION only. Public TradeIntent remains proposalOnly true and executionAuthorized false. Plan/envelope live_authorization and broker_submission_allowed are always false. No broker/live implementation.
implementation.nativeContractConsumer: Frozen vertex-contracts ContractAuthority only for StrategySpec/TradeIntent validation, canonical encoding, digest and exact timestamp-to-epoch conversion. No copied public schemas. Exact immutable artifact ID and digest, not latest strategy aliases.
implementation.trustedInputs: A private request is not an authentication mechanism. Authenticated owner supplies approved immutable policy and trustworthy current data/journal observations. A caller-authored source string, hash or evidence ID alone cannot establish current rights or external gate completion.
